research_question: How to evaluate Multiagentsystems in a efficient way?
inclusion_criteria: Focus on multi-agent systems, agentic workflows, or collaborative AI environments
Investigates safety evaluation, benchmarking frameworks, or vulnerability assessments
Addresses alignment, adversarial robustness, hallucination containment, or secure tool use
exclusion_criteria: Focuses only on single-agent frameworks or standalone Large Language Models
Purely performance-based metrics or cost optimization without safety benchmarks
Traditional robotics hardware collision studies without cognitive or digital reasoning software
Non-peer-reviewed secondary literature, informal technical blog posts, or short abstracts
